targets.outcome_quote: This study replicates the 2003 ﬁndings of Caspi et al. (12), reinforcing the role of the interaction between genetic and environmental inﬂuences in the etiology of youth major depression. We identiﬁed an interaction similar to that observed in the original study, using a categorical outcome within a multiplicative model.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The discussion opens with an overall statement that this study replicates the original findings; the abstract likewise calls the results replicated. This overall verdict takes precedence over the later contrast concerning the main effect of maltreatment regardless of genotype. Secondary triallelic and sensitivity analyses do not replace the central biallelic replication verdict.
